answer: An identity activates after finishing a verifiable delay chain: 12 sequential segments, each seeded by the previous output, taking 2 hours and impossible to compress with parallel machines. Renewal every 10 epochs raises the target by 50 percent, like climbing from a reef toward a summit. A farmer running 20 identities needs 20 chains per cycle, so cost multiplies rather than spreading as one ripple across accounts. Any 3 of 9 checkpoint nodes verify a proof in under a second, reject reused outputs, and publish failures, so honest agents pay time once per cycle while minting stays slow.
